fullData.title: Time to Count Bears!
fullData.description: Practice counting out exact groups of friendly bears in neat lines and arrays.

challenges.hint: Try tapping each bear one by one as you count them.
challenges.narration: Let's work together to count out some of our bear friends from the pile!

challenges.hint: Take your time and tap each bear slowly so you don't miss any.
challenges.narration: Here is a new pile of bears. Let's see how many we can count out.

challenges.hint: Count them in order from left to right to keep track easily.
challenges.narration: You are doing wonderful! Let's count out a nice long line of bears.

challenges.hint: Remember to touch each bear as you say its number.
challenges.narration: Look at all these bears! Let's count them carefully.

challenges.hint: Check your work by counting your selected bears one last time.
challenges.narration: This is our last challenge. Let's count out this final group of bears with a big smile!
